notes: Breadboard bank naming: the picture labels the upper half rows j-f and the lower half rows e-a, so the upper half is treated as bank 'b' (rows f-j) and the lower half as bank 't' (rows a-e), matching the catalogue's row letters.

Pushbuttons straddle the centre gap. Their left-column legs (signal side: pin wire, pull-down resistor) are side 1 (1.l top, 1.r bottom). Their right-column legs (+5V side) are side 2 (2.l top, 2.r bottom).

Button columns read from the image: 6/8, 11/13, 16/18, 21/23, 26/28. Signal wires land in rows c/b of columns 6, 11, 16, 21, 26 for pins 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Exact rows and columns are estimated from the picture.
Power rail hole numbers (tp.n, bn.n) are approximate. The top + rail (tp) carries +5V. The bottom - rail (bn) carries GND, with the black wire from the Leonardo's GND next to 5V.
Resistors are 10k ohm pull-downs, from the pin column to the GND rail, set as value=10000. Each pushbutton's other side is tied to +5V through a red jumper from the top + rail.
The code and software parts of the tutorial are not part of the build graph.
